system.description: While your Shroud of Flame is active, you can spread wings of fire and fly until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery, moving at a rate of up to 20 feet (6 m) per round in any direction. You can also take one other non-movement action as an extra action on your turn. Action to initiate.
